_comment: Reefball-only gear (ADR 0040, M3-C07-05): what the Tamsule outfitter sells. It never touches battle equipment. Each piece is of one kind (band: the side-band every diver of the side wears; float: the side's own practice float), and the side wears at most one piece of each kind. A worn piece adds its bonus to every diver on the player's side, capped at rules.stat_max. Owning a piece is the flag rbl_gear_<id>_owned; the worn piece of each kind is the flag rbl_worn_<kind> (its id, or empty). Prices are placeholders for Combat's balance check.
